headline: Korea's Hana Bank to open a representative office in Uzbekistan
summary: The Central Bank of Uzbekistan has accredited a representative office of Hana Bank, one of South Korea's largest commercial banks. The office will develop cooperation with state and financial institutions and the private sector.
why: Hana Bank is a major South Korean commercial bank, part of Hana Financial Group, and its expansion into Uzbekistan adds foreign banking presence in a fast-growing Central Asian market.
